query_analysis.original_query: Could you help me design a monitoring system to predict early fouling in demisters for separators handling heavy hydrocarbon condensates. What sensors and control strategies would you recommend?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a comprehensive monitoring system for early detection of fouling in demisters used in separators processing heavy hydrocarbon condensates. Identify suitable sensors and design an effective control strategy to mitigate fouling.

communication_strategy.information_flow: Real-time data analysis and fouling prediction

clarification_questions: What type of demisters are currently in use and what are their specifications?
Are there any specific challenges or issues observed with the current demister performance?
What are the typical operating conditions (temperature, pressure, flow rates) of the separators handling heavy hydrocarbon condensates?
